parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Iron is extracted from its main ore in a blast furnace.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Coke and iron ore are added at the top of the blast furnace. Name one other substance that is added at the top of the blast furnace. ....................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Temperatures inside a blast furnace can reach 2000 ° C. Name two substances that react together, in the blast furnace, to produce this high temperature. ....................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Zinc is extracted from zinc blende.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) When zinc is extracted, it is formed as a gas. The gaseous zinc is then converted into molten zinc. State the name of this physical change. ....................................................................................................................................... [1]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Copper has the following properties. ● It has a high melting point. ● It has a high density. ● It is a good conductor of electricity. ● It has variable oxidation states. ● It forms a basic oxide. ● It forms soluble salts.
